title: References │ Experience Impressive Building Projects | Brückner Maschinenbau
content: For the main location of Brückner Maschinenbau – the global market leader in film stretching technology – a modern design concept was developed for the commercial logistics and finance departments at the Siegsdorf site. The concept includes spacious lounge areas and flexible desk-sharing workstations, which cater to the desire for on-site communication and personal interaction. As part of this pilot project to develop new office environments, the Lindner Group made a significant contribution with a range of high-quality space solutions. Notably, the flexible Lindner Cube room-in-room system stands out: the system's curved glass panels, offer an aesthetic and functional enhancement to the office landscape, contributing to the creation of open yet soundproofed areas. These bespoke solutions play a crucial role in the visual and functional optimisation of the new work environments, providing Brückner Maschinenbau employees with an effective and appealing working atmosphere. title: The Brückner Group – a global technology company
content: ##### Brückner Group GmbH. # The Brückner Group – a global technology company. The Brückner Group has been a family-owned company since it was established in 1960. It stands for technological expertise and the highest quality in the field of machinery and installations for the production and processing of plastics and other packaging materials. * Brückner Group: Strategic management holding and management company for all business areas of the Brückner Group. * Brückner Maschinenbau: World market leader in production installations for the manufacture of films for high-quality packaging material and technical applications. * Kiefel: The leader in serial and special machinery for the processing of plastics in the automobile, refrigeration, medical technology and packaging industries. * PackSys Global: Global player for special machines for the packaging industry. The companies within the group operate independently but share a focus on engineering as their core added value as well as their striving for leadership in technology and on the world market in their individual segments.
